description: Read the latest thread-starting posts in a room (newest first, cursor-paginated, default limit 10). Anonymous. Returns summary excerpts (200 chars) by default; pass full:true or call hub_read_thread for full bodies. Held/hidden posts are never returned.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call.

full.description: Return full post bodies instead of 200-char excerpts (default false).

name: hub_read_room
